edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a protective direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: CBT for insomnia works by breaking conditioned arousal around the bed and tightening sleep drive with stimulus control and sleep restriction.
edges.summary: What makes this pair believable is not one flashy paper but the way the literature stacks up: the 2023 Chambe meta analysis in J Sleep Res already points to cognitive behavioural therapy tracks with lower risk or better outcomes, and later studies mostly refine the size of the effect rather than overturning it. In practice this reads more like a real risk signal than a one-off finding.
edges.caveats: Healthier-user bias, screening intensity, and baseline risk can all inflate apparent benefit in observational work, so the magnitude should be read conservatively.
